description:
Caveat; every great habit takes a bit of effort.

It’s not as easy or comfortable as scrolling through social media, or watching Netflix.

It will feel GREAT, but at the price of energy and intention. 

So it’s not gonna stick unless you find greater value in the habit than you do the pleasure of something fun and easy.

But it also won’t stick if you shame yourself til you’re deterred from ever trying.

Where’s the middle ground? That’s for you to figure out. Try, fail, try again. You’ll figure it out. This is just to give you a bit of clarity as you do.

transcript: Fuck gratitude. Fuck journaling. Fuck any good habit if you feel obliged. It defeats the purpose. Habit is only a habit if you do it repeatedly. And when it becomes obligation, you stop doing it. You don't have to do shit. Yes, empirically, gratitude will make you happier. But if the point is to be happier, guilting yourself isn't helping. Lay down the burden. When the guilt is gone, gratitude looks pretty nice. Be free. I'm going this way if you wanna come.
